settings.name: terminal.defaultShell
settings.title: Default shell
settings.description: What a new terminal runs. The menu beside + in a terminal tab row opens any other shell.

settings.name: terminal.outputLimit
settings.title: Output kept per terminal (MB)
settings.description: How much of a terminal's output you can scroll back through. Beyond it the oldest lines are dropped. Applies to terminals opened afterwards.

settings.name: terminal.fontSize
settings.title: Font size
settings.description: The size of the text in every terminal, in pixels. No text size under Appearance changes it.

settings.name: terminal.suggestions
settings.title: Suggest earlier commands
settings.description: Whether a terminal shows the rest of an earlier command in grey as you type at a bash, zsh or PowerShell prompt. → or End at the line's end takes it.

settings.name: terminal.commandColors
settings.title: Color typed commands
settings.description: Whether a terminal colors the command you type at a bash, zsh or PowerShell prompt: its name, options, strings, paths, variables, operators, keywords and comments. Text the shell colors itself keeps its own colors.

settings.name: terminal.completionList
settings.title: Complete with a list
settings.description: Whether Tab at a bash, zsh or PowerShell prompt opens a list of what can follow: files, folders, commands, branches, scripts and a command's options. Turned off, Tab goes to the shell, which completes as it does on its own.

settings.name: terminal.linkClick
settings.title: Open clicked links
settings.description: Where a link you Ctrl+click in a terminal opens, Cmd+click on macOS. Sign-in links that tools print need your own browser, where you're signed in.
